entities.summary: Countess Kata Bethlen de Bethlen (1700–1759), sometimes referred to as Katherine Bethlen, was one of the earliest Hungarians to write memoirs. She was born on November 25, 1700, in Bonyha, Hungary, and died on July 29, 1759, in Fogaras, Hungary.
